retirement_age.notes: Public pension (folkepension) age is 67 in 2026 for people born from 1 July 1955. It rises to 68 from 2030 (born from 1 January 1963), 69 from 2035 (born from 1 January 1967) and 70 from 2040 (born from 1 January 1971), as adopted by the Folketing in May 2025. The age is reviewed every five years against life expectancy; the next review is scheduled for 2030.

open_questions: Median age: sources found conflict (UN-based figures of 41.3 and 42.3 for 2025) and no national statistics office or Eurostat median value was retrieved; left null. Statistics Denmark gives a mean age of 42.7 on 1 January 2026 (via Danish Wikipedia citing Statistics Denmark), which is not a median.

Next national election: no fixed date. The last Folketing election was held on 24 March 2026; the next must be held by 23 March 2030, and the Prime Minister may call it earlier (valg.im.dk). Date left null.

Mette Frederiksen has been Prime Minister since 27 June 2019 without a break. Her third cabinet took office on 3 June 2026 after the 24 March 2026 election; in_office_since keeps the 2019 date. The Prime Minister has no fixed term.

Birth dates for Frederik X (Britannica) and Mette Frederiksen (Wikipedia) come from reference works, not an official Danish government page; an official source (e.g. kongehuset.dk, stm.dk) could not be retrieved in this run.
